ns2:course.label: Advanced Problems in LIS
ns2:course.description: Variety of newly developed and special courses on selected problems within the seven curriculum domains that reflect different aspects of library and information science, offered as sections of LIS 590: Information organization and knowledge representation; Information resources, uses and users; Information Systems; History, economics, policy; Management and evaluation; Social, community, and organizational informatics; Youth literature and services. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. May be repeated.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. May be repeated.
